concept_briefs.strategic_focus: Väitetty asiantuntijuus vs. Näkymätön osaaminen: Autoasi sanoo olevansa asiantuntevin, mutta digitaalisessa kanavassa tämä on näkymätöntä.
concept_briefs.format_guidance: Focus on proven YouTube formats: documentary-style, interview series, or educational content. Episodes should be 8-15 minutes. Prioritize professional production quality and clear brand alignment. The series should have obvious rewatch and share value.
concept_briefs.success_hypothesis: This concept directly addresses Autoasi -autonhuoltoketju's top strategic priority (threat) with a proven format that minimizes execution risk while delivering measurable brand value.

concept_briefs.format_guidance: Design for TikTok/Reels first: vertical format, 30-90 seconds, hook in first 3 seconds. Embrace platform-native aesthetics and trends. Consider creator collaborations. Content should feel bold and contemporary, not like traditional brand advertising.
concept_briefs.success_hypothesis: This concept enables Autoasi -autonhuoltoketju to aggressively address their gap with bold positioning that differentiates them in the market and captures attention on high-engagement platforms.
